stop: First timeout/OOM/nonfinite/identity/counter failure stops queue; retain every slot and completed artifact; no retries, fallback or extra cases
interpretation: Poor finite probe scores do not change the predeclared sampler or select a checkpoint
prerequisites: 01 implements versioned runner and CPU checks
new explicit user authorization bound to final implementation and run/GPU

clock_rules.total: 3600s from launch BEFORE preflight/load; deadline never extended
clock_rules.S1: min(total_deadline,sampling_start+2400), shared by all60; no per-case reset
clock_rules.overhead: All load/save/trace validation overhead included. Sum stage caps3000 does not authorize600s extra model work; remaining total time is only preflight/orchestration, no transfer of unused caps.

counter_rules.reservation: Reserve before forward; observed and reference encodings counted individually; f00/f10 Q zero encoder; no unlisted real warmup/verification/retry.

required_ledger: Predeclare all480 Q,60 sample and240 trace slots; terminal completed/failed/not_run_after_stop, attempted/reserved/completed counters, timings/GPU/peakallocated/artifact hashes; preserve partial output.
